Account mutation helpers for data, owner, lamports, executable flag, and resize delta.

# Purpose
This C file implements account mutation helpers for `fd_borrowed_account_t`. It provides functions to read mutable account data and to change account fields such as owner, lamports, data contents, data length, and executable state. Each function checks the account state and transaction rules before it writes any change, and it returns an executor status code when a rule fails. The code follows the rules from Agave `transaction_context.rs`, as shown by the source links in the comments.

The main technical role of the file is to enforce transaction-time constraints for account updates. Functions such as [`fd_borrowed_account_set_owner`](<#fd_borrowed_account_set_owner>), [`fd_borrowed_account_set_lamports`](<#fd_borrowed_account_set_lamports>), [`fd_borrowed_account_set_data_from_slice`](<#fd_borrowed_account_set_data_from_slice>), [`fd_borrowed_account_set_data_length`](<#fd_borrowed_account_set_data_length>), and [`fd_borrowed_account_set_executable`](<#fd_borrowed_account_set_executable>) verify conditions like write permission, ownership by the current program, executable state, rent exemption, and data resize limits. The helper [`fd_borrowed_account_update_accounts_resize_delta`](<#fd_borrowed_account_update_accounts_resize_delta>) updates the transaction-wide resize delta after a data size change.
